what: DTE Energy supplies electricity and natural gas in Michigan, serving the Detroit area and much of the state. It also owns a non-utility business in renewable natural gas and industrial energy services.
customers: About 2.3 million electricity and 1.3 million gas customers in Michigan, plus industrial energy clients.
money: regulated generation and delivery in southeastern Michigan
renewable natural gas, industrial energy and trading
moat: A regulated monopoly across much of Michigan, with returns set by the state commission.
risks: Debt of about $26 billion against almost no cash
Michigan regulators set allowed returns and have been demanding on reliability
Storm-related outages have drawn regulatory and political criticism
Heavy capital spending requires continuous financing
opportunities: Data centre agreements in Michigan raise projected load growth
Grid reliability investment adds to the base it earns a regulated return on
watch: Data centre load commitments and rate case outcomes.
